verdict.rationale: Bento documents an official hosted MCP server at mcp.bentonow.com that lets an AI assistant look up subscribers, create broadcasts and track events "all through natural conversation." A probe confirms the MCP server docs exist. Bento also offers an in-product AI builder where you "describe what you want in plain text," plus Bento Skills to guide agents across MCP, CLI and SDK surfaces. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works in practice, and detail on the in-app plain-text AI builder's scope beyond a marketing tagline.
